name: Sweat & Tonic
description:
Get accurate answers about Sweat & Tonic, a boutique fitness and wellness studio in Toronto, straight from the studio's own published information. This connector lets Claude search the studio's live content and pull full details on class programs, the current schedule, membership pricing, instructors, on-site treatments (facials, skincare, and chiropractic care), and how to book, so you can plan a visit or compare options without hunting across the web.

It exposes two read-only tools. search returns ranked results, each with a title, a source URL, and a text snippet. fetch returns a document's full text and its canonical URL. Every result links back to the exact page it came from, so answers stay grounded in the studio's real content and are citable to source, with no stale third-party listings.

Courtyard AI operates this connector for Sweat & Tonic with the studio's explicit authorization, and keeps its content current automatically as the studio updates its programs, schedule, and pricing. All information is public business content. No account, login, or personal data is required. The connector is strictly read-only: it never makes bookings, processes payments, or performs any other action. It only retrieves and cites the studio's published information.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Sweat & Tonic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Sweat & Tonic to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://ai.sweatandtonic.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Sweat & Tonic MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Sweat & Tonic scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Sweat & Tonic MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sweat & Tonic provides these MCP tools: fetch and search.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Sweat & Tonic?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Sweat & Tonic in consumer-health on the Manufact MCP catalog include Vitals Vault, It's Complicated — Therapist Directory, courtsapp, CheckCells, and COROS.

_published_faq.name: Does Sweat & Tonic MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Sweat & Tonic does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Sweat & Tonic is developed by Courtyard AI. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
